structured_output.what_is_happening: A 22-minute-old "Super inu" token is trading on a PumpSwap pool. It did not graduate from the pump.fun bonding curve: migrated_unix is 0 and the launchpad and deploy platform are blank or unknown. The creator seems to have set up the pool directly and holds 100% of the unlocked LP, and also owns 15.95% of the supply. The packet lists another "Super Inu" (SI) at about $12M market cap doing about $230k of volume per hour, plus a larger listing with implausible figures. That makes this a late copycat. Volume is about $466k against a $27k market cap, or 12x turnover. Price is +82% over the hour but -22% over 15 minutes, and about 34% below its high. Unique buyers (1,881) far outnumber unique sellers (55). Liquidity ($38k) is larger than market cap, which is unusual.

narrative.description: This is a copy of the trending Super Inu dog-meme ticker. It has no socials, website, description or DexScreener profile of its own.
narrative.why_spreading: It borrows attention from a larger same-name Super Inu token that is actively trading. Buyers searching the name may end up in this pool by mistake.

token_connection.why_this_token: The only link is the shared name. Nothing marks this as the canonical Super Inu.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Super Inu (SI) DEW9... at about $12M market cap with $231k volume per hour. Caa2... shows $3.5B market cap, which is likely bogus or a wrong reading. 8ALH... is dead with $0 liquidity. All of them predate this token.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN shows no bundlers, snipers or bot share, and only 16.6% fresh wallets, which looks reasonably clean. But 1,881 unique buyers against 55 unique sellers, 12x turnover, and a creator holding 16% of supply plus all the unlocked LP point to a setup where the creator gains from inflows. GMGN also tags one rat_trader wallet holding 15.95%, which is the creator's own 15.95% stake. There is no paid promotion.
authenticity.uncertainty: Without chain-level trace data I can't tell whether the buyer breadth comes from real misdirected Super Inu traders or from farmed wallets.

structural_risks: The creator holds 100% of the LP, unlocked, and can pull liquidity at any time
The creator holds 15.95% of supply, flagged as a rat trader
It is a copycat of an active $12M same-name token
Price is already down 22% over 15 minutes and 34% from its high

structured_output.counterargument: Buyer breadth is very strong: nearly 1,900 unique buyers and only 55 sellers in 22 minutes, with no bundlers or snipers. Copycats of a hot ticker sometimes get a second wave as spillover from the main token. A $27k market cap is small enough that one more wave of misdirected buyers could double it. The creator has also shown a best previous token peak of about $237k.
unknowns: Whether the creator will pull the LP
Why liquidity is larger than market cap
Whether the $12M Super Inu keeps pumping and spills over into this token
Whether the buyer wallets are real

structured_output.thesis: This is a copycat of an active Super Inu token. Its pool was created directly, and the creator holds all of the unlocked LP plus 16% of supply. The coin has pumped 82% and is already fading. Rug risk is high and a 2x from here is unlikely. It ranks below the typical coin in the pool.
